COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
CRLA No.415 of 2023
Hon’ble Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Rajendra Singh Azad, Advocate for the 
appellant.
2. Mr. J.S. Virk, Deputy Advocate General with Mr. 
Rakesh Joshi, Brief Holder for the State.
3. This appeal is preferred against impugned judgment 
and order dated 09.05.2023, passed by learned Ist
Additional Sessions Judge, Roorkee, Haridwar, in Sessions 
Trial No.11 of 2016, in which, three persons were charged
for offence punishable under Section 302 r/w 34 namely, 
Bholu alias Rocky, Mintu alias Madan and Tellu s/o Jaggu 
Singh, out of which Bholu was also charged with the 
offence under Section 25 of Arms Act, 1959. Out of these 
three persons, Bholu alias Rocky was convicted for the 
offence punishable under Section 302 IPC and 25 of Arms 
Act, while the other two persons were acquitted.
4. Against acquittal of Mintu alias Madan and Tellu 
s/o Jaggu Singh, son of the victim, who is also 
informant/complainant, has filed this appeal under Section 
372 Cr.P.C.
5. As per the office report, the appeal is well within 
time.
6. Admit the appeal.
7. Issue notice to respondent nos. 2 and 3.
8. Steps to be taken within a week.
9. Since the L.C.R is already summoned in CRLA No. 
318 of 2023, hence list this appeal along with CRLA 
No.318 of 2023.
10. List this case on 10.10.2023. 
(Pankaj Purohit, J.) (Manoj Kumar Tiwari, J.)
 19.09.2023 SK
